decision.status: no_candidate_adopted; retain prior adopted groups changes
methods: Only same(): first parents preloaded + halving using preloaded value
same() shared-parent fast exit, with/without root-pair exit
same(a,a) early return after existing bounds checks
All prototypes GCC default only; Clang/native retain original. No production change.
results: 3042 process runs; same path/inode, shuffled variants,13reps, n32/32768/500000,13shapes; every checksum and sampled root/size matches independent full-compression reference.
Preload large mixed about8% faster but star about12% slower; medium same(v,v) about11% slower.
Shared-parent large same(v,v) about73–75% faster but star6–16% slower, medium1024groups22–47% slower.
Equal-arg shortcut large same(v,v)about89% faster but star11% slower and mediumother groups8.5% slower.
decision.decision: All rejected because meaningful regressions in other large operations; small regressions alone were not the rejection criterion. Prior E-Core audit read, here remeasured on P-Core.
decision.validation_limit: Prototypes independently checked for benchmark operations only; no claim of final exhaustive checked/sanitizer validation for rejected code.
